verses.en: When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion
And the earth throws up her burdens (from within)
And man cries (distressed): 'What is the matter with her
On that Day will she declare her tidings
For that thy Lord will have given her inspiration

verses.ar: يَوۡمَئِذٍ يَّصۡدُرُ النَّاسُ اَشۡتَاتًا ࣢ۙ لِّيُرَوۡا اَعۡمَالَهُمۡؕ‏
verses.en: On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done)

verses.ar: فَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيۡرًا يَّرَهٗؕ‏
verses.en: Then shall anyone who has done an atom's weight of good, see it

verses.ar: وَمَنۡ يَّعۡمَلۡ مِثۡقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَّرَهٗࣖ‏
verses.en: And anyone who has done an atom's weight of evil, shall see it
